description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called PermissionsSettings and related subviews that manage and display permission settings for various capabilities, such as location, notifications, microphone, and accessibility in a macOS application.

classes.name: LocationAccessSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI view managing location access settings, including location mode and precise location toggle.

classes.name: PermissionStatusList
classes.description: A SwiftUI view displaying a list of permission capabilities and their current statuses, with refresh functionality.

classes.name: PermissionRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a single permission capability, showing its status, granting button, and description.

methods.name: requestLocationAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location authorization based on the selected mode.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles permission changes for a specific capability, ensuring permission is granted and then refreshing state.

methods.name: refreshStatusTransitions
methods.description: Performs multiple delayed refreshes of the permission statuses to account for system setting changes.
